verdict.rationale: Apify's platform is built around running Actors (scrapers) at scale, with API clients supporting batch runs, tasks with multiple input configs, pagination, retries, dataset export, proxy/session rotation to avoid blocking, and async support (e.g. Python asyncio log streaming, JS client run/call methods) — all directly enabling asynchronous batch URL scraping. Missing for 10: no explicit benchmark/case-study showing thousands of concurrent URLs processed, and no independent third-party performance validation of scale claims.
